body:
Founder real-time: "joined queue no bots visible." Confirmed live via a
real diagnostic client: real player positions up to ~1500 units apart on
NEWPIT, a real ~325x320-unit level. Root cause: SCENE_CUSTOM_LEVEL (what
QUEUE uses) had no real spawn-point case -- fell into a generic
"unknown scene" fallback (origin, or a random 500-unit-radius point),
unrelated to the actual loaded level's geometry.

Fixed: computes a real spawn point from the currently loaded level's own
geometry (bounding-box center, golden-angle-spaced per slot, confined to
60% of the level's real half-extent). Live-verified: bots now cluster
within ~100-280 units of each other (was 1500+), zero retreat-spam since
redeploy. Full go test ./... and python -m unittest green. Live server +
bot pool redeployed, fresh Windows client built.

Commit: SHANKPIT@b8a417e.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-57: real spawn points for custom levels -- was scattering players up to 500 units apart
